column1: # resolver corpus sweep baseline: every fixture query under
# corpus: 310 queries, 38 schemas. 11780 cells: 3763 accept, 8017 refuse.
# cell rows: query, schema, verdict, sentinel, detail. A refusing cell's
# detail digests the error text and is expanded by the strconv.Quote'd msg
# row carrying the same digest; an accepting cell's detail digests the
# marshalled ValidatedQuery. Comparing this file against a fresh sweep sorts
# every disagreement into a category, including the one a verdict-only diff
# misses: a cell that refuses before and after under a different sentinel.
# what a row does not carry: the resolved model itself, which an accepting
# cell digests and a reader recovers by resolving; the error's dynamic type,
# since two errors sharing a text and an errors.Is behaviour are one value
# here; and any query or schema outside test/data/resolver.
